title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00117 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
15:00 - 16:00: Reporting continued from f-99. Continued to skid cantilever to f-04 9m inboard/1. 25m port. Continued work with aft PRS
16:00 - 16:30: Installed covers to skidding system. Meanwhile held TBT for connecting HP hose to f-04 and for removal of well head cover/installation of split cover
16:30 - 17:30: Connected HP hose to f-04. Meanwhile tested aft PRS. Prepared subs for pressure testing
17:30 - 19:00: Performed line test down to XMT. Performed test of XMT cross 20/345bar for 5/10min. Good test
19:00 - 19:15: Performed pre-job meeting to remove moonpool hatches
19:15 - 20:15: Removed hatches and installed split hatch
20:15 - 21:30: Adjusted scaffolding around xmas tree. Prepared lines and bled off a and b annulus to MGS. Worked to fill a and b annulus with sea water. Bled off pressure and removed tree cap from xmas tree w/ rigfloor winch
21:30 - 23:45: Hooked up hydraulic pump for local control of DHSV an HMV. Meanwhile worked to fill a and b annulus with sea water, carried out TBT for r/u cement head
23:45 - 00:00: Worked to p/u cement head in moonpool using overhead crane and transfered to TDS lifting chains
